thesis: The page is one issue of The Thaw Issue, a Buffalo winter magazine about houses and pipes: every section is a department, and the signature is the page-number footer that advances as you read through Field Notes, Freeze Map, The Double, Letters and Classifieds.

signature.name: Department Masthead + Page-Number Rail
signature.summary: A thin lake-blue rule tops each section carrying the department name in small caps serif on the left and a mono page number (00-06) on the right; the rule draws left-to-right on scroll via --sw-p. Reused in hero masthead, five departments, and footer.

palette.family: Lake Erie Blue + Furnace Red + Snow Paper

motion.intro: Cover slides up translateY(100%→0) 700ms ease-out while masthead fades in; cover lines stagger-fade 100ms each. Skippable; text readable at 0ms under reduced motion.
stories: Department rule draws left-to-right via --sw-p clip-path wipe as each section enters; page number counts 00→06.
Cover photo parallax-shifts at 0.3x rate inside its frame (no pin, no scroll-jack).
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, transform-origin left, @media (hover:hover) only.
